mapper.select: SELECT t.id AS tid, t.name AS name, t.note, COUNT(b.id) AS `count` FROM t_type t LEFT JOIN t_blog b ON t.id = b.typeid AND b.issue = 1 AND b.ispublic = 1 AND b.isdel = 0 GROUP BY t.id, t.name, t.note ORDER BY `count` DESC

SELECT t.id AS tid, t.name AS name, t.note, COUNT(b.id) AS `count` FROM t_type t LEFT JOIN t_blog b ON t.id = b.typeid AND b.issue = 1 AND b.ispublic = 1 AND b.isdel = 0 AND b.`userid` = #{userId,jdbcType=VARCHAR} GROUP BY t.id, t.name, t.note ORDER BY `count` DESC
SELECT t.`name` as `name`,count(b.id) as `value` FROM t_type t LEFT JOIN t_blog b on t.id=b.typeid GROUP BY t.`name`
SELECT t.id tid,t.name,t.note FROM t_type t WHERE `name` LIKE CONCAT('%',#{name},'%') ORDER BY tid DESC
